# Lindsey Optics

> Professional cinematography optics manufacturer specializing in Brilliant Macro lenses, diopters, directors viewfinders, and motion picture filters for the film industry.

Founded by Dwight Lindsey and based in Lancaster, California, Lindsey Optics produces precision optical tools for cinematographers including the acclaimed Brilliant Macro lens series, Large Format Directors Viewfinder, and professional filter systems like RotaPol and Brilliant Full Spectrum IR ND Filters. The company serves the motion picture industry with high-quality cine accessories tested with Zygo laser interferometry.

## Key Topics

- Brilliant Macro Lenses
- Brilliant Tray Mount System
- Large Format Directors Viewfinder
- Close-Up Diopters
- Cinematography Filters
- RotaPol Polarizers
- Brilliant Full Spectrum IR ND Filters
- Cine Prime and Zoom Lenses
- Directors Viewfinder Modules
- Motion Picture Optics
- Professional Camera Accessories
- Dwight Lindsey
- Zygo Laser Interferometer Testing
- Full Frame and Super-35 Format
- Rota-Frames Filter Systems

## Brilliant Macro Lenses & Diopters

- [Lindsey Optics Cine Lenses - Brilliant Macro Lens](https://www.lindseyoptics.com/lenses/): Brilliant Macro lens products (+1, +2, +3) for cine primes and zooms
- [Lindsey Optics Diopters](https://www.lindseyoptics.com/close-up-lenses-diopters/): Close-up diopter lenses with Brilliant Tray Mount systems

## Directors Viewfinders

- [Lindsey Optics Large Format Directors Viewfinder](https://www.lindseyoptics.com/viewfinders/): Large Format Directors Viewfinder with Full Frame and Super-35 modules

## Cinematography Filters

- [Filters for cinematography](https://www.lindseyoptics.com/filters/): Professional cinematography filters including RotaPol and Rota-Frames
